Name: Jeelh's Natural Greenhouse
Author: Jeelh
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/FGalk28.png[/img]

This is a greenhouse expansion mod, there are 4 seasons to choose from.
15x20 crop area in the greenhouse, the orchard has 16 places to plant fruit trees.

The season changes automatically as of mod version 1.0.3,
but you can manually override the season with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you'd rather it always be one season inside.

The seasons are purely cosmetic, you can plant anything in the greenhouse as usual.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCilBwk.png[/img]

﻿[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[b]2[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]3[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b]4[/b]. Download Jeelh's Seasonal Greenhouse
[b]5[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
[b]6[/b]. Launch the game and use GMCM to select which greenhouse and orchard you would like
[i]
Make sure your greenhouse is completely empty before installing this mod or you could face some issues.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jtASrD2.png[/img]
